title: Publish proof & supporting surfaces
intro: Extra surfaces that keep media, brand, voice, secrets, and public publish honest — same gates as the rest of the cockpit.

items.title: Convert / media pipeline
items.body: Thin convert helpers (document and media tooling) turn PDFs, office docs, and audio/video into text or intermediates the agent can reason about. Prefer a bounded convert step over pasting opaque binaries into every turn.
items.lesson: Convert for the task; do not retain every intermediate forever.

items.title: Brand production
items.body: Brand rules live as loadable skills for email, web, PDF/print, and UI — so agents stay on voice, colour, and typography without inventing a new look each session.
items.lesson: Brand is a procedure, not a vibe prompt.

items.title: Desktop voice-turn confirm
items.body: When the human wants to speak a turn: mic → local STT → confirm (use this / edit) before the agent treats it as the ask. Same respect as typed input — no silent act-on-noise.
items.lesson: Confirm the transcript before committing work.

items.title: Secrets via Bitwarden
items.body: Capture secrets through a desktop dialog into Bitwarden — not into Composer. Password Manager holds human credentials; Bitwarden Secrets Manager holds machine tokens agents may resolve. Confirm length or success — never echo the value into chat, logs, or commits.
items.lesson: Isolate tokens from the AI conversation. Chat is not a vault.

items.title: CI publish checks
items.body: Public pages sync from content JSON, then run automated content and Playwright UX checks (desktop + mobile). Green checks are the proof class for publish — not “looks fine locally”.
items.lesson: Publish is a proof class, not a hope.
